'''Tacticians''' were specialists within the ranks of military forces who were responsible for creating battle tactics. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] made use of tacticians.

==Description==
Tacticians were battlefield leaders, even in the face of insurmountable odds. They assessed the situation, determining the best way to accomplish a goal with the resources at hand while keeping their people alive. The forces under the tactician's command looked to them in battle to lead them, either to victory or during a withdrawal.<ref name="AOR-Core">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] tactician [[Beryl Chiffonage]] devised several combat tactics for use by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] in combat. One of the tactics, utilizing the [[power harpoon launcher]] of the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] to wrap around the legs of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], was used to great effect by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="EGVV" />
